formElement.label: .PEM Key Property Path:
formElement.documentation: Property path containing the .pem key content (default: /myPipelineRuntime/delineaSecret/pem).

formElement.label: Destination File Path:
formElement.documentation: File path on the agent where the .pem key will be written (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_rsa or /tmp/delinea.pem).

formElement.label: File Permissions:
formElement.documentation: POSIX permissions for the written file (default: 0600 for SSH private keys).

formElement.label: Overwrite Existing File:
formElement.documentation: Whether to overwrite destination file if it already exists.

formElement.label: Output Property Sheet:
formElement.documentation: CDRO property sheet where output metadata will be saved.
